title: Request: Add actions for selecting current desktop
line: Clicking the current desktop in the Pager can now open the Overview, and does so by default.
explanation: The Pager's "Selecting current virtual desktop" setting only offered "Does nothing" and "Shows the desktop", so there was no way to reach KWin's Overview (the successor of Desktop Grid and Present Windows the reporter asked for) from it. Open merge request plasma-desktop!2256 adds this but was written before the pager files moved, so it no longer applies. The change ports that MR to master: a third choice "Shows the overview", which invokes KWin's Overview shortcut over D-Bus, and makes it the default.

commits.message:
applets/pager: open the Overview when clicking the current desktop

Clicking the current desktop in the pager could only do nothing or show
the desktop. This adds a "Shows the overview" option that opens KWin's
Overview and makes it the default, giving a mouse way to reach it.

BUG: 404618

media.caption: Pager settings on master: only "Does nothing" and "Shows the desktop".
New "Shows the overview" choice, selected by default.
Master: clicking the current desktop (Desktop 1) in the pager does nothing.
With the fix: the same click opens the Overview.
